description: Look up a Arbitrum One transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use arb_receipt, for emitted events arb_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xf03682db039f7b1b72ddf4d17572738f142cf63ecb36c90afa570430ea9774c4. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: arb_tx
title: Arbitrum One transaction
